items.title: Vercel Connect adds webhook triggers for more providers
items.summary: now supports webhook triggers for , , , , and .Vercel ConnectResendXTwilioNotionTelegramConnect receives webhook events, such as Telegram bot messages or emails received by your Resend domain, and forwards them to an endpoint in your Vercel project. It verifies incoming requests and handles provider heartbeats and verification challenges for you.To get started:You can turn triggers on or off later in the connector’s settings.In the connector’s  tab, select  to watch incoming trigger events.ObservabilityLiveThese connectors join existing trigger support for Slack, Discord, Microsoft Teams, GitHub, and Linear.Learn more in the .Connect triggers documentationRead moreOpen  in the dashboard. Enable triggers when creating a connector for your provider or in an existing connector’s settings. Connect registers webhooks automatically for Resend and Telegram.Vercel ConnectFor Twilio, Notion, and X, use the webhook URL from Connect and follow its instructions to complete setup in the provider’s settings.Add a trigger destination to choose the project and endpoint that should receive events.
